newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers bonds, new certificates for auction.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers bonds, new certificates for auction.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it would open a new floating rate certificate (CCT) paying a first coupon of 3.45 percent at its forthcoming mid-month paper auction. The previous CCT paid a first coupon of 3.80 percent.
The Treasury also said it would re-open existing three, five and 10-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) offerings. It gave the following details:
* 3rd tranche 1/1/97 3-yr BTPs paying a 6.0 pct coupon.
* 11th tranche 1/11/96 10-yr BTP paying a 7.75 pct coupon.
* 1st tranche 1/1/97 7-yr CCTs paying an initial 3.45 pct coupon.
The amount of paper offered will be announced on January 10.
Subscriptions for the CCT and 10-year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT January 15.
Subscriptions for the three and five year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT on January 16. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
